svg.title: DTB explorer: the PL011 node in the chapter's blob
svg.desc: Bytes 0x310 to 0x35f of the --dtb-out file. At 0x310, 00000001 is FDT_BEGIN_NODE, followed by the name pl011@9000000, a NUL and padding. At 0x324, 00000003 is FDT_PROP with length 0x18 and name offset 0, the compatible property, whose value is arm,pl011 NUL arm,primecell NUL. At 0x348, a second FDT_PROP with length 0x10 and name offset 0x65 is reg: four cells 00000000 09000000 00000000 00001000. The root says #address-cells 2 and #size-cells 2, so reg is one range: address 0x0900_0000, size 0x1000.
svg.text: pl011@9000000 in the blob (from xxd -s 784 -l 80 v.dtb)
parent (root): #address-cells = 2, #size-cells = 2 so one range = 4 cells = 16 bytes
With #address-cells = 1, a range is 12 bytes and 16 does not divide: dtc warns.
